cache_reuse_condition.requirement: Reconstruct the original contract using original factory/cohort/model/checkpoint/budgets and extracted original tokens and require the stored contract hash. Candidate selector must not feed Exit. This parity has not yet been measured.

dataset_review.execution_note: Initial capped attempt did not execute because another full pytest owns the heavy-job lock. This completed metadata-only operator uses the standard library, hashes small saved JSON results, and loads no weights or market datasets.

design.coverage: All256 fixed entries and512 sides preserved. Require complete model exits before cutoff for the whole fixed cohort; never select closed/winning rows out of an incomplete cohort.
design.frozen_policy_definition: Entire original ONLINE512 Entry-forward/token plus Exit mapping. The original three Entry Q values remain inputs to Exit; freezing only Exit-head weights or detaching gradients is insufficient.
design.inference_inputs: Only existing causal Entry inputs and original entry_q_joint_hidden; label, fill and exit metadata never enter model inputs. Month membership is hash-proven against canonical Entry-clock audit.
design.minimal_composition: Apply a copy of the existing linear Entry readout to the frozen entry_q_joint_hidden after the original forward has formed the original Exit token. Its selection Q must never overwrite original Entry Q in the Exit context. Bind selector weights separately. Existing full-policy outcomes remain reusable only while the complete Exit function and context are preserved.
design.remaining_gap: Current ONLINE512 entry_q_joint_hidden for256 rows was not persisted. TRAIN16 input/target diagnostic caches do not provide these256 representations. Bind one minimal native extraction and any analytic readout fit separately before execution; no fits/forwards are activated here. Evaluator must separate selection Q from original Exit token without altering that token.
design.reuse: Existing native campaign and guards, current causal dataset/forward, checkpoint owner, existing proven readout formula, Entry policy builder and marked one-position accounting. No new architecture, market engine, features, threshold search or separate VAL runner.

selector_split.semantics: Disjoint labels for a possible selector-fit diagnostic on reused TRAIN; source model/outcomes are already development evidence, not independent validation.

design.target_semantics: Signed realised net returns from the predetermined frozen policy for both sides, as noisy regression samples. Costs already included once; FLAT0. No pathwise max, winner selection, added liquidation, fake EXIT or teacher bootstrap. Not conditional-expectation truth.

fixed_method: Center fit127 X and Y only; Ledoit-Wolf delta from fit X only; Sxx=X.T@X/n; lambda=delta*trace(Sxx)/d/(1-delta); solve (Sxx+lambda I)W=Sxy with unpenalized intercept; all three actions, FLAT target0. No search or check-driven adaptation. Historical operator is a formula reference, never a launch path.
next_missing_measurement: Bind exactly one native extraction of original ONLINE512 entry_q_joint_hidden for the same256 rows; verify original Entry Q and full original Exit context before a single separately scoped analytic fit.
positive_result_means: At most grounds for separately bound chronological development assessment; no independent generalization or profitability claim.
predeclared_go_requirements: Exact cohort, original Q and Exit-context parity; finite outputs; all labels and costs preserved.
On check129, both LONG and SHORT MSE and centered error improve versus original512 and fit-only constants.
Fixed argmax with FLAT0 selects trades and net is positive over all129 opportunities and in existing one-position accounting.
Report months, action counts and concentration; unclear or concentrated evidence does not automatically authorize escalation.
review_consensus: One existing regularized linear selector on original frozen Entry hidden, targeting realised signed frozen pi512 returns. This is a reused-TRAIN falsification diagnostic, not demonstrated edge. Original Entry Q and entire Exit token/function stay unchanged.
risk: 127 fit rows versus128 hidden coordinates plus intercept; regularization does not prove generalization. Both fit and check are reused TRAIN and source model was already fitted.
stop_rule: If a requirement fails or economics remain unclear, close this selector hypothesis. Do not change lambda, thresholds, costs, split, features or training steps to rescue it. A technical extraction failure may receive only its minimal evidenced correction.
